paragraphs: Grandma and Lily are at the bus stop. A sign says: "Bus stop." Lily sees a white line on the street. There is a sign next to the line. It says: "Stand behind the line." Lily and Grandma stand behind the line. A big green bus comes. It is a nice day. The bus stops.

Lily and Grandma get on the bus. There are many chairs. Lily sees a sign. It says: "Bags under the chairs." Grandma puts her bag under the chair. Lily sits between Grandma and a boy. "Hello!" says the boy. "Hello!" says Lily. "Is this the bus to the park?" asks Grandma.

The bus stops at the park. The park is big and green. "We are here," says Grandma. A sign at the park says: "Park." Grandma picks up her bag. Lily waves to the boy. "Goodbye!" says the boy. Lily is happy. Signs are good for us. They say what to do.
text.summary: Grandma and Lily take a bus to the park. They read signs at the bus stop, on the bus, and at the park.
